sources.intended_use: Second-level navigation and administrative context; never a language boundary.
limitations: The layer includes territories, cities, and communes and must not be presented as a territory-only inventory.
The represented boundary year is 2017 and requires renewed administrative review before public release.
The distributor appends a non-JSON System.IO.MemoryStream marker, which the build removes only after verifying the raw-file checksum.
